# Vendored Pi components

Runtime source from [lanej/dotfiles at 89dc1655](https://github.com/lanej/dotfiles/tree/89dc1655444cb088b787a5f256b07b22f92146c1/tools/pi-components). Studio includes the reusable selector, condition status and activity primitives, and conditions panel so they remain available outside dotfiles. The [component guide](https://github.com/lanej/dotfiles/blob/89dc1655444cb088b787a5f256b07b22f92146c1/tools/pi-components/README.md) covers the complete API and runnable example. Refresh the exported sources together; the original package retains its own development tooling and interaction tests. Studio's strict profile checks this snapshot alongside its consumers.
